AiFx.description:
Exchange rate between the price currency and the budget unit (decision 7).

`operator`: the operator sets `rate_ppm` with its date. `fetched`: one fixed HTTPS source
(`source_url`, fixed parser) is read inside the maintenance window. The automatic
`ecb_daily_xml_v1` parser requires the exact ECB daily XML URL and returns EUR per USD.
Automatic refresh requires `ai.local_only: false`. A rate older than `max_age_days`
makes cost-limited reservations deny.
AiFx.title: AiFx

AiLocal.description: Operator-declared limits of the local model (checked before any download).

license_ack.description: The operator accepted the model's license.
license_ack.title: License Ack

AiLocal.title: AiLocal

AiModelPolicy.description:
Selection rule (ADR 0002 section 2): families and an evaluation budget, not a model.

The weekly selection (A05) only ever switches within the configured provider and data
class; it never expands sharing or changes the provider.
AiModelPolicy.title: AiModelPolicy

AiModelPrice.description: Operator-declared price of one model with its date; stale prices block a switch.
AiModelPrice.title: AiModelPrice

AiPrice.description: Operator-declared prices in budget-currency micro-units per million tokens.
AiPrice.title: AiPrice

AiScopeLimits.description: Per-window (UTC calendar month) limits for one budget scope; unset = not limited.
AiScopeLimits.title: AiScopeLimits

instruction.description: Operator-authored application-wide goals for workload contract proposals. These goals take precedence over repository instructions and grant no authority to apply a proposal.
instruction.title: Instruction

on_critical.description: Critical exposed finding response (unset: quarantine; ADR 0002 section 5).
on_critical.title: On Critical

stateless.description: Explicit contract that the application keeps no data: containment may stop it without a backup. Not inferred from missing data; needs `data_path: null`.
stateless.title: Stateless

BuildPolicy.description: Isolated repository builds (R03). The container tier is weaker than VM isolation.

allow_container_isolation.description: Permit the rootless dedicated-user build tier, labelled 'container isolation, no VM protection' in all evidence.
allow_container_isolation.title: Allow Container Isolation

package_sources.description: Hosts the build network may reach (package and base-image sources).
package_sources.title: Package Sources

Channel.description: Outbound notification destination; credentials stay in secret references.

ContractRequirements.description:
What the workload asks of its isolation. Safe values are the defaults; the
suitability check rejects the rest regardless of what a proposer claims.
ContractRequirements.title: ContractRequirements

Egress.description:
Outbound policy, enforced per service UID in nftables (IPv4 and IPv6).

`public-web` allows DNS via the host resolver plus TCP 80/443 to public
addresses. It is not a domain allowlist.
Egress.title: Egress

Events.title: Events

max_response_ms.description: A healthy answer slower than this counts as a hang.
max_response_ms.title: Max Response Ms

probe.description: Probe kind; unset means http. tcp checks the loopback port accepts; container runs the image's own declared healthcheck.
probe.title: Probe

allow_backup_pause.description: Permit the operator's registered backup capture to pause this workload.
allow_backup_pause.title: Allow Backup Pause

allow_restart.description: Maintenance contract for restarts: lets the controller restart this service when it is down or unhealthy (budgeted, audited). Set false to exempt it.
allow_restart.title: Allow Restart

immediate_if_known_exploited.description: Disconnect a known-exploited, network-reachable service without notice.
immediate_if_known_exploited.title: Immediate If Known Exploited

notice_minutes.description: Notice before an unscheduled one-hour window opens.
notice_minutes.title: Notice Minutes

MaintenancePolicy.description:
Server-wide maintenance windows (ADR 0002 section 8).

Distinct from the per-workload `Maintenance` contract on projects/services.

allow_reboot.description: Explicit consent for host reboots in a window.
allow_reboot.title: Allow Reboot

weekly_window.description: Fixed one-hour window, for example 'Sun 03:00 Europe/Berlin'.
weekly_window.title: Weekly Window

UpdatePolicy.description:
Root-owned contract for operator-verified image updates (ADR 0002 sections 3, 5, 8).

Trust anchors live here, never in the artifact being validated: the image
attestation must be signed by one of `signers` (independent test/signing
identity) and the approval by one of `approvers`; the two sets must differ.

allowed_migrations.description: Data compatibility kinds an update may declare.
allowed_migrations.title: Allowed Migrations

apply_seconds.description: Time the update needs; it must fit before window end.
apply_seconds.title: Apply Seconds

min_healthy_s.description: The patch controller updates a service only after this much continuous health (unset: 1800; 0: healthy now).
min_healthy_s.title: Min Healthy S

repository.description: Expected image repository; candidates from elsewhere are refused.
repository.title: Repository

rollback_window_s.description: Window after apply in which the patch controller may roll back an update with migration `none` that became durably unhealthy (unset: 1800; 0: never).
rollback_window_s.title: Rollback Window S

UpdatePolicy.title: UpdatePolicy
